svg.aria-label: Flight log: first-author paper submitted to SESAR Innovation Days 2026; Comunidad de Madrid excellence scholarship 2026; 1st place IndesIAhack 2025; 1st place BeTech Hackathon 2025; joined GPDS 2025; 2x FIRST LEGO League regional winner. GPA 8.48/10, 7 Matrículas de Honor, 4 hackathons with 2 wins.
